import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Distribution of transaction amounts by type
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

# 2. Transaction count by type
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
axes[0, 1].bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62', '#8da0cb'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Count by Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
for i, v in enumerate(transaction_counts.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
hour_counts = data.groupby('hour_of_day').size()
axes[1, 0].plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#e78ac3')
axes[1, 0].fill_between(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#e78ac3')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 4. Scatter plot: Amount vs Hour, colored by transaction type
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    axes[1, 1].scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
                      label=trans_type, s=100, alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Transaction Type')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
